NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 250829 LTAAYNYX DEC 2025.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 291240 LGACYAYC DEC 2025.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE
AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE
AIR TRAFFIC IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH THE ATS UNITS.
AS HAS BEEN CONSISTENTLY NOTED IN THE PAST, AND WITH THE REF (B)
291240 LGACYAYC DEC 2025 GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE TO TURKEY, PARTS
OF THE AREA MENTIONED IN TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY
2026) OVERLAP AREAS OF NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE.
FURTHERMORE, THE TURKISH REQUEST ENTAILS LONG-TERM RESERVATION
OF AIRSPACE CONTRARY TO THE RELEVANT ICAO RECOMMENDATIONS.
CONSEQUENTLY, THE AREA AS REQUESTED IS NOT AVAILABLE.
FOR THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EU
ECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE TO ATHINAI FIR.

MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION.
GREEK AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF ACFT REGISTERED IN GREECE SHALL 
NOT ENTER UIR KYIV (UKBU), FIR LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV), FIR 
DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), FIR ODESA (UKOV), FIR 
ROSTOV (URRV), FIR CHISINAU (LUUU) EXCEPT FOR THE PORTION OF 
AIRSPACE DESCRIBED IN AND RELATED TO RELEVANT NOTAM AND AIP SUPS 
ISSUED BY REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA.
SAID OPERATORS AND ACFT OWNERS SHALL ALSO AVOID FLIGHT OPERATIONS 
WITHIN THE BUFFER ZONE EXTENDING OUT TO 200NM ALONG THE 
UKRAINE/RUSSIA BORDER.
ADDITIONAL RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT PLANNING DECISIONS SHALL BE 
TAKEN BEFORE OPERATING IN THE FOLLOWING AIRSPACE: MOSCOW (UUWV).

properties.originalText:
MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION:
ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR 
OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE 
RUSSIAN FEDERATION ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, LAND IN, TAKE-OFF FROM, 
OR OVERFLY GREEK NATIONAL AIRSPACE, EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, MEDEVAC AND 
SAR FLIGHTS, OR ANY OTHER FLIGHT, AS IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR 
EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, BY PERMISSION OF THE GOVERNMENT OF THE 
HELLENIC REPUBLIC. ALL ACFT OPERATORS OF NON-SCHEDULED FLIGHTS 
BETWEEN RUSSIA AND GREECE, OPERATED DIRECTLY OR VIA A THIRD COUNTRY, 
SHALL NOTIFY ALL RELEVANT INFORMATION CONCERNING THE FLIGHT,
AT LEAST 48 HOURS IN ADVANCE TO HELLENIC CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY
CONTACT: FLIGHTPERMISSION(AT)HCAA.GOV.GR.

WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:

(NIPIS-KUMBI), A14 AND M1 (SIT-KAVOS), N129 (LATMO-KUMBI) AFFECTED.

2.1.- FLIGHT PLANS MUST BE SUBMITTED AND PERMISSION BY APPROPRIATE

ACTIVITIES SHALL ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH ATHINAI CONTROL.
3.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
3.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING ACTIVITIES, NON EXERCISE
AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREA
DESIGNATED IN PARA (1) ABOVE.
3.2- OTHER AIRCRAFT UNABLE TO AVOID THE ABOVE DESCRIBED AREA WILL
BE AUTHORIZED TO ENTER THIS AREA AFTER SPECIAL PERMISSION
BY APPROPRIATE ATC UNIT.

ATHINAI FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.- AREA: 361230N 0284400E - 360000N 0291000E -
354300N 0291000E - 352100N 0300000E - 342726N 0295509E -
343232N 0285541E - 350500N 0280000E - 361230N 0284400E.
AWYS R19 AND M601 (LAKAD-EXELA), G18 AND L609 (NILAS-ALKIS), L995
(IRBAX-VANZA), N128 (OTHON-FOXLI), L52 (TIRMO-VAXOS), N134
(MASES-VANZA), L53 (ANIDE-MASES), N129 (TIRMO-KUMBI), R78 AND M978
(NIPIS-TOSKA), W54 AND Y661 (ORVIS-ANTAR) AFFECTED.
2.- PROCEDURES FOR UNMANNED AIRCRAFT:
2.1.- PRIOR ENTERING ATHINAI FIR, COORDINATION AND RADIO CONTACT
SHALL BE ESTABLISHED WITH THE COMPETENT ATHINAI FIR ATC UNIT,
ACCORDING TO ICAO ANNEX 2, APPENDIX 4, PARAS 1.3 AND 1.4 PROVISIONS
FOR THE UNMANNED ACFT FLIGHTS.
2.2.- UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SHALL NOT AFFECT HELLENIC NATIONAL AIRSPACE
LESS THAN 10NM ACCORDING TO AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.1-1, PARA 1.1.1.2.1.
2.3.- FLIGHT PLANS SHALL BE SUBMITTED ACCORDING TO ICAO ANNEX 2,
APPENDIX 4, PARA 1.6 AND ACCORDING TO AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.10 AND GEN
1.7-1.

properties.name: A3970/26 / LGGG
properties.originalText:
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 200903 LTAAYNYX OCT 2026.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 261133 LGACYAYC OCT 2026.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER
(HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE
AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE AIR TRAFFIC IN THE AREA IS THE
HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE ATS AND ATC
UNITS.
MOREOVER, AS IT WAS NOTIFIED THROUGH THE REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION 
MESSAGE 261133 LGACYAYC OCT 2026, THE GREEK COMPETENT AUTHORITIES DID
NOT PROMULGATE A NOTAM IN RESPONSE TO REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST 
GIVEN THAT PART OF THE AREA REQUESTED OVERLAPS AREA OF NATIONAL
SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT
APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR.

WHICH IS THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, AND THEY 
REMAIN UNCHANGED.

NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4091/26 (040916 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A4941/26 (041159 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
REF (C) TURKISH NOTAM A4904/26 (021222 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
REFERENCE IS MADE TO THE ABOVE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A4941/26 
LTAAYNYX IN ORDER TO STATE THAT THE ATHINAI/ISTANBUL FIR BOUNDARY 
BETWEEN POINTS 404500N0261000E AND 360500N0300000E HAS BEEN 
ESTABLISHED BY ICAO REGIONAL AGREEMENTS (REACHED IN THE SECOND 
MIDDLE EAST REGIONAL AIR NAVIGATION MEETING, ISTANBUL 1950 AND 
SUBSEQUENTLY APPROVED BY THE ICAO COUNCIL ON 14 DEC 1950, DOC 7055 
MID/2-RAC) WITH THE PARTICIPATION AND APPROVAL OF TURKIYE AND IN FEB 
1958, (DOC 7870, EUM/IV) AND CONSEQUENTLY IS FOUNDED ON THE FIRMEST 
POSSIBLE LEGAL BASIS AS NOTED IN OUR A1709/07 LGGGYNYX NOTAM. 
FURTHERMORE THE SAID ATHINAI/ISTANBUL FIR BOUNDARY WAS DEPICTED ON 
CHART NUMBER 7 ATTACHED TO THE REGIONAL AIR NAVIGATION AGREEMENT 
WHICH WAS REACHED IN THE THIRD REGIONAL AIR NAVIGATIONAL CONFERENCE 
(PARIS 1952) AND SUBSEQUENTLY APPROVED BY THE ICAO COUNCIL ON 23 
JUNE 1952. 
ACCORDINGLY, GREECE HAS BEEN ASIGNED RESPONSIBILITY FOR ALL ATM 
SERVICES AND ICAO PURPOSES AS WELL AS FOR SAR WITHIN 
ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR AND IS THE ONLY COMPETENT THEREIN. 
THEREFORE, THE DEFINITION OF EXERCISE OR SAR AREAS WITH REFERENCE 
TO THE AFOREMENTIONED ATHINAI/ISTANBUL FIR BOUNDARY, AS THIS 
BOUNDARY IS CLEARLY DEPICTED IN THE ICAO AERONAUTICAL CHARTS, IS A 
JUSTIFIED AND RIGHTFUL PRACTICE NOT LEAVING SPACE FOR MISLEADING OR 
MISINTERPRETATIONS. 
ON THE AFOREMENTIONED BASIS THE REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4091/26 (040916 
EUECYIYN NOV 2026), STATED THAT WITH REFERENCE TO REF (C) TURKISH 
NOTAM A4904/26 (021222 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) A PART OF THE AREA AS 
DESCRIBED IN REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4091/26, STRICTLY LIES WITHIN 
ATHINAI FIR WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS 
ACCORDING TO ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION 
SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP). 
CONSEQUENTLY, THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A4941/26 (041159 EUECYIYN NOV 
2026) HAS NO GROUND, CANNOT PRODUCE ANY INTERNATIONALLY LEGAL EFFECT 
WITHIN ATHINAI FIR / HELLAS UIR AND IS CONSIDERED NULL AND VOID. 
THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE NOTAM WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR IS 
THE REF (A) A4091/26, ISSUED BY GREECE.
